    Reference Class representing a country as Country_object

    Country_object.Rd

    Object representing demographic and model-specific information for a single country used in the MRC projection framework.

    Each country object contains demographic inputs and parameters that define fertility, mortality, migration, and religious switching dynamics, as well as country-specific settings used for scenario projections.

    Details

    Country_object stores initial and projected data, specific options and results of the MRC projection for each country

    Fields

    year

    Current year, for projections

    period

    Current period, used for labels in previous_ tables

    name

    Country Name of country (character)

    code

    Code of country [standard ISO 3166-1] (numeric)

    Region

    Country region

    structure_data

    List containing structures at every step of the projection, before running project() contains only starting structure

    mortality_rates

    Matrix containing survivability rates for every step of the projection

    age_specific_fertility_rates

    Matrix containing asfrs for every step of the projection

    fertility_differentials

    list containing matrices of fertility differentials by religion for every step of the projection

    sex_ratio

    Vector containing fraction of boys at birth for every step of the projection

    switching_matrices_list

    List containing matrices of switching probability for every religion

    outmigration_rates

    List containing matrices of migration rates for every religion and age group

    destination_matrix

    Matrix containing rates of migration for every country, sex and religion

    start_fertility_group

    number of the first age group included in the fertility calculations

    fertility_factorization

    takes two values - 1 is factorizes each age group separately and 2 factorizes all age groups together

    previous_mortality

    List of matrices containing structure of population mortality in previous steps

    previous_fertility

    List of matrices containing structure of births in previous steps

    previous_asfr

    List of matrices containing data of asfr in previous steps

    previous_fertility_exposure

    List of matrices containing structure of woman population in previous steps

    old_fertility_factors

    List of calculated fertility factors to equalize births after using differentials

    previous_switching

    List of matrices containing structure of switching population in previous steps

    previous_immigration

    List of matrices structure containing structure of migrants population in previous steps

    previous_emigration

    List of matrices structure containing structure of migrants population in previous steps

    migration_list

    technical purposes

    emigration_list

    technical purposes

    migrant_sum

    technical purposes

    temp

    List for technical purposes, stores data during calculations
